dict.Adaosul se pune la prețul de achiziție f: The markup is applied to the purchase price without VAT; VAT is calculated last, on the selling price without VAT.
dict.Din prețul de achiziție și adaosul comer: From the purchase price and the markup you get the price without VAT, the VAT and the price with VAT, rounded up to 10 bani for the label; then the markup in lei and the margin, and the status shows the products sold at a loss (red) and those below the minimum markup you choose (yellow).
dict.Marja e partea din prețul de vânzare (fă: The margin is the part of the selling price (without VAT) left after the cost of the goods: a 25% markup means a 20% margin.
dict.Prețul rotunjit e cel de pe etichetă; ad: The rounded price is the one on the label; the markup and the margin are calculated from it. New prices are also entered in Sheets → Goods receipt note.
